tvShow.name: Margo's Got Money Troubles
tvShow.overview: The daughter of a former Hooter's waitress and an ex-pro wrestler, Margo is a recent college dropout and aspiring writer. Faced with a new baby, mounting pile of bills, and dwindling number of ways to pay them, Margo must find a way forward.

episodes.name: The Hungry Ghost
episodes.overview: Margo is left reeling when her first year of college is derailed, forcing her to make a tough decision that changes everything.

episodes.name: Homecoming
episodes.overview: Margo brings baby Bodhi home. Shyanne bets on her future as Jinx re-enters the picture.

episodes.name: Jinxed
episodes.overview: Margo explores a new line of work while Jinx settles in. Shyanne and Kenny find themselves at a creative crossroads.

episodes.name: Buddies
episodes.overview: Worlds collide as Margo makes new friends. Jinx reunites with his wrestling roots.

episodes.name: Grudge Match
episodes.overview: Plans to expand HungryGhost's digital empire are halted when secrets divide Margo's family.

episodes.name: Lariat Takedown
episodes.overview: Margo goes head-to-head with Mark. Jinx and Susie have a rough day.

episodes.name: Lock and Load
episodes.overview: Margo has her day in court.
